necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9). Given the concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms and potential embolic risk, mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I34.0, justifying the medical necessity despite the denial code CO-197.
